usedFor: Razorpay reports failed payments and Callingly connects leads by phone, so “Payment Fails” can run “Call Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Fails” in Razorpay, then “Call Lead” in Callingly
bestTemplate.why: A failed payment connects a lead to the first available team member through your Callingly account.

watchOut: “A New Refund Is Created” also reaches “Call Lead”, so a refund could ring your team.
